ui.done_pending: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwe kule foni futhi zizongezwa esithombeni se-{org} lapho kuba nesiginali — akudingeki wenze lutho.
ui.done_private: Babona imiphumela ehlanganisiwe kuphela, hhayi izimpendulo zomuntu ngamunye.
ui.done_saved: Impendulo yakho isengezwe esithombeni se-{org} sokuthi umphakathi wabo ulandela kanjani uJesu.
ui.install_android: Faka inhlolovo ye-{org} kule foni ukuze ivuleke ngaphandle kwesiginali.
ui.install_ios: Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana, bese uthi “Engeza Esikrinini Sasekhaya”, ukuze ivuleke ngaphandle kwesiginali.
ui.no_org_body: Ayikho inhlangano kuleli kheli. Hlola isixhumanisi osinikiwe — kungenzeka sinephutha, noma sisusiwe.
ui.not_fielding_community: {org} ayikavuli le nhlolovo. Uma othile esabelane nawe ngayo, mtshele ukuthi isixhumanisi asikasebenzi.
ui.not_fielding_note: Akukho okwenzayo lapha okuqoshwayo, ngoba akukho lapho kungaqoshwa khona.
ui.not_fielding_public: {org} ayikavuli inhlolovo yayo yomphakathi. Uma othile esabelane nawe ngayo, mtshele ukuthi isixhumanisi asikasebenzi.
ui.offline_banner_body: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwa kule foni futhi zithunyelwa ngokwazo lapho isiginali ibuya.
ui.offline_first_body: Le nhlolovo idinga isiginali okokuqala ivulwa efonini. Ngemuva kwalokho isebenza ngaphandle kwesiginali. Zama futhi uma usuxhunyiwe.
ui.preview_banner: Ukubuka kuqala kokuhumusha okusalungiswa — izimpendulo aziqoshwa.
ui.type_here: Bhala okuningi noma okuncane ngendlela othanda ngayo…
ui.welcome_body: {org} ifuna ukufunda ukuhamba nabasha njengoba belandela uJesu. Izimpendulo zakho eziqotho ziyasiza. Kuthatha cishe imizuzu engu-{minutes} futhi akuvezi ukuthi ungubani.
ui.about_body: Asikubuzi igama lakho, i-imeyili noma inombolo yocingo, futhi asigcini ikheli lakho le-inthanethi kanye nezimpendulo zakho. Sibuza kuphela iqembu lakho leminyaka nokuthi uhlala kuphi cishe. I-{org} ibona kuphela imiphumela ehlanganisiwe yabantu abaningi — ayilokothi ibone izimpendulo zakho zodwa. Ungayeka noma nini ngokuvala leli khasi.
ui.ended_body: Lolu cwaningo lungolwabantu abaneminyaka eyi-13 kuya kwengama-30, ngakho akukho okunye okumele ukuphendule. Siyabonga ngokuvakasha — akukho nokukodwa okukhethile okugciniwe.
ui.collection_locked_banner: Ukubuka kuqala — Inkomba ayikaqali ukuqoqa izimpendulo, ngakho izimpendulo zakho azigcinwa.

orientation.text: Yikuphi kulokhu okufana nawe kakhulu njengamanje?

options.other_religion: UNkulunkulu ukhona, kodwa ngilandela enye inkolo

follow_exposure_internal.text: Ngifuna ukuqhubeka ngifunda kabanzi ngokuthi uJesu ungubani nokuthi wafundisani.

follow_exposure_external.text: Ngike ngathola amathuba okufunda lokho uJesu akufundisa nokuthi kungani kubalulekile.

follow_response_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi intethelelo yezono itholakala kuphela ngokukholwa kuJesu.

follow_response_external.text: Ngikhethe ukulandela uJesu, engikholwa ukuthi unguNkulunkulu.

follow_formation_internal.text: IBhayibheli lingiphonsela inselelo yokucabanga kabusha ngezinqumo nokuziphatha kwami.

follow_formation_external.text: Ngithandaza ngezindlela ezingingenisa ebudlelwaneni bomuntu siqu noNkulunkulu.

follow_multiplication_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi ivangeli liyizindaba ezinhle empilweni yami futhi kufanele ukuba ngabelane ngalo nabantu abangewona amaKristu.

follow_multiplication_external.text: Ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule, ngike ngatshela umuntu ongamlandeli uJesu okuthile ngoJesu.

mission_exposure_internal.text: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukuba yingxenye yomsebenzi kaJesu.

mission_response_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi ukwabelana ngomlayezo kaJesu kuyingxenye yokumlandela.

mission_response_external.text: Ngamukele ukuba yingxenye yomsebenzi kaJesu njengomthwalo wami njengomlandeli kaJesu.

attention_check.text: Ukuze sazi ukuthi ufunda ngokucophelela, sicela ukhethe ethi “Kuyiqiniso ngami kancane” kulo mbuzo.

mission_formation_internal.text: Ukusebenzela abanye njengengxenye yomphakathi wobuKristu kuyingxenye ebalulekile yendlela engilandela ngayo uJesu.

mission_formation_external.text: Ngizama ukukhombisa abantu abangewona amaKristu ukuthi ukulandela uJesu kuyibumba kanjani impilo yami yansuku zonke.

mission_multiplication_internal.text: Ngifuna ukumema abanye abantu ukuthi bangijoyine emisebenzini exhumene nomsebenzi kaJesu.

mission_multiplication_external.text: Ngike ngasiza omunye umuntu ukuba akhule ekulandeleni uJesu.

world_exposure_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi ukulandela uJesu kuletha okuhle kwangempela kubantu nasemhlabeni.

world_exposure_external.text: Ngenza izinqumo eziqondisa impilo yami entweni enkulu kunami.

world_response_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi ukholo lwami lumayelana nokungaphezu kwempilo yami siqu. Kufanele lulethe umehluko emhlabeni.

world_response_external.text: Ukulandela uJesu kwenza umehluko wangempela endleleni engiphatha ngayo abantu nendlela engisabela ngayo ezidingweni ezingizungezile.

world_formation_internal.text: Ngifuna ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu empilweni yami yansuku zonke, ngisho noma ihlukile kweyami.

world_formation_external.text: Ukuba umuntu onothando olukhulu kubo bonke abangizungezile yinto engisebenza kuyo nsuku zonke.

world_multiplication_internal.text: Ngikholwa ukuthi abalandeli bakaJesu kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuletha izinguquko ezinhle emiphakathini yabo.

world_multiplication_external.text: Ngikhuthaza amanye amaKristu ukuthi axhumanise ukholo lwawo nendlela aphila futhi akhonza ngayo.

follow_exposure_internal_unengaged.text: Nginentshisekelo yokuzwa imibono ehlukene ngoNkulunkulu noma ngezikamoya.

follow_exposure_external_unengaged.text: Ngike ngathola amathuba okuzwa lokho amaKristu akukholelwayo ngoJesu.

follow_response_internal_unengaged.text: Ngicabanga ukuthi kukhona okuthile emvelweni yomuntu okudinga ukulungiswa, okungaphezu kwalokho esingakwenza sodwa.

follow_response_external_unengaged.text: Ngike ngacabanga ngezizathu zokukholwa nezokungakholwa kuNkulunkulu.

follow_formation_internal_unengaged.text: Ngicabanga ukuthi iBhayibheli linikeza okuthile okufanele kucatshangelwe mayelana nokuthi umuntu aphile kanjani.

follow_formation_external_unengaged.text: Ngiyazinikela isikhathi sokuzindla ngemibuzo ephathelene noNkulunkulu, ezikamoya, noma incazelo yempilo.

follow_multiplication_internal_unengaged.text: Ngicabanga ukuthi ukukhuluma ngemibuzo yokholo kungaba nenzuzo, ngisho noma abantu befinyelela eziphethweni ezihlukene.

follow_multiplication_external_unengaged.text: Ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezedlule, ngike ngakhuluma nomuntu ngemibono noma imibuzo yami ngoNkulunkulu noma ngezikamoya.

mission_response_internal_unengaged.text: Ngikhethe ukuthatha umthwalo wokuletha umehluko omuhle emhlabeni ongizungezile.
